utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be there a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just confirming, we’re still good for the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still good — I’ll be there a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m hoping we can make around 8:15 work for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — 8:15 works for me, and I’ll keep an eye out for the final headcount. Just send any updates my way if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Jules — I’ll let you know if the headcount changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — send me the riders and pickup times, and I’ll line up the carpool in order.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the rider list and pickup times next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — send them whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep the carpool neat and in order.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — just text me by tonight if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll text you tonight if anything changes. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ve got it set for 7:30 tomorrow with Sam and Lena.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the timing stays clear. I’ll let the group know about the 7:30 carpool with Sam and Lena.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — thanks, Vik. See you tomorrow at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, 7:30 still works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — 7:30 it is, then. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate it — see you then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m still checking the schedule. If I get anything concrete, I’ll text you right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell — that works for me. Just text me as soon as you have the schedule, and I’ll keep my day clear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’m waiting on a couple updates, and I’ll text you as soon as I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send over the riders and pickup times soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — just send them over when you can, and I’ll keep the seats clear and be ready for 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Gus — I’ll send the list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m still on for the carpool, and I’ve already confirmed the time and pickup with Leo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — thanks, Hana. If there’s still a seat, I’m in; just send me the pickup details and I’ll catch up when I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check with Leo and send you the pickup details if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies tonight and let you know if we’re short on anything before tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—while you check that, I’m still tracking the pickup spots. I’ll start at the north end of the block and follow the stops in order.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll check the supplies tonight and let you know if we need anything before tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—3:15 at the front loop works for me. Thanks, Noah!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—thanks, Faye. I’m a little behind on the carpool details, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries—just text me if anything changes, and I’ll see you at 3:15 by the front loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam — I’m setting up the carpool now, and you’re welcome to join if you want a spot. Want me to save you one?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — yes, please save me a spot. I can do weekdays, and I can help with morning drop-off or afternoon pickup if the times line up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, Sam, and I’ll keep you in the loop on the timings. Thanks for being flexible with drop-off or pickup!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies tonight and let you know if we’re short on anything before tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the carpool on the usual plan unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll let you know tonight if we need anything. Otherwise, we can stick with the usual plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, 7:30 still works for me—I’ll let everyone know it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks for confirming—I'll plan to start at the north end of the block and keep the route in order.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I'll pass that along, and we’re all set for tomorrow at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please text me by tonight if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll text you tonight if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, Tuesday and Thursday still work for me at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll plan on Tuesday and Thursday at 8:15, and I’ll keep the seats clear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks Gus — that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down. I’ll send the pickup details soon!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — that works for me. I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll plan on 7:30 and send the pickup details soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I can still do the afternoon pickup and meet you by the front loop at 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — that works well for me. I’ll be ready at 3:15 by the front loop.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Eli — I’ll see you at 3:15 by the front loop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, 7:30 works for me — thanks for the reminder. I’ll be ready and waiting out front.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 7:30 is set — I’ll swing by then and pick you up out front.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Sam — I’ll be out front and ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I just want to double-check the time and pickup details before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I’m thinking around 8:15, and I’ll confirm the pickup details once everyone’s set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — 8:15 works for me, and I’ll wait for the final pickup details once everyone’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — just send me the time and pickup spot, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll send the time and pickup spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out for it and join as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit behind on the carpool updates — did Jules say if the schedule’s set yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t seen a final update yet—last I heard it was still being confirmed, so I’d check with Vik for the latest count and time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — I’ll check with Vik for the latest count and time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep — I’m still leaving at 7:20, and you’ll still have a seat.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll be there a few minutes early and pick you up at 7:20.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds great, Leo — I’ll be ready at 7:20.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, Rosa — are we still good for the carpool at the usual time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re still good for the usual time, and I’ll keep the route lined up. Just send me any rider updates and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — I’ll send any rider updates if anything changes.

injected.text: Update: the morning carpool now leaves at 8am from the church parking lot, not 7am from the school lot.
